interest: An activity, subject, hobby or experience that a person enjoys or dislikes doing, watching or talking about.
want: Something a person finds valuable to have or experience: a condition, outcome, environment, or quality they hope for in other people or in a relationship.
value: An internal way of being or motivation a person chooses to act from, such as honesty or curiosity; it describes their own conduct, never how other people are or act.
boundary: A behaviour, situation or topic a person wants to avoid or will not accept in a relationship.
